items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Harry Carney, he was playing baritone on the date.

ctx.x: Gene Cedric was on that date, and Harry -- you get old and doty all of them (inaudible) -- Harry Carney, he was playing baritone on the date. It's so long ago, you know, I can see the personnel and I think of the nicknames, and I can't recall their real names, you know.
The Golden Gate Quartet, I used to work with them a lot. Carl Kress and I used to record for them for Columbia.
